question: What was the total number of medals won by India at the 2025 Special Olympics World Winter Games held in Turin, Italy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**33**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won a total of 33 medals** at the **2025 Special Olympics World Winter Games** held in **Turin, Italy**. This includes medals across various sports categories such as skiing, figure skating, snowboarding, and ice hockey.
 
• The **Special Olympics World Winter Games** are held to provide athletes with intellectual disabilities an opportunity to compete at an international level. It showcases their skills and promotes inclusivity in sports.
 
• India's performance was exceptional, as the team showcased remarkable talent and determination across multiple events. *Hence, the statement regarding the total medals being 33 is correct.*
 
• Athletes from India excelled in sports like alpine skiing and snowboarding, securing top positions in various categories, contributing significantly to the medal count.
 
• The medals won by India not only highlight the athletic abilities of the participants but also emphasize the growth of winter sports in the country. *Hence, the correct answer is 33.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Special Olympics World Winter Games:**

 
 
• **The Special Olympics** is an international organization that conducts sports events for people with intellectual disabilities. The Winter Games include various sports like skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, and ice hockey.
 
• The **2025 edition** was hosted in **Turin, Italy**, a city with a rich history in winter sports, having previously hosted the Winter Olympics in **2006**.
 
 
 
• **India's Participation:**
 
 
• Indian athletes trained extensively under the guidance of coaches and support staff to compete at the Winter Games.
 
• The delegation represented India in multiple events, showcasing their skills and earning recognition on the global stage.
 
• **Example:** Indian athletes performed exceptionally well in alpine skiing, earning multiple medals in this category.
 
 
 
• **Medal Distribution:**
 
 
• The medal tally of **33** includes gold, silver, and bronze medals across different sports.
 
• This achievement is a testament to the growing support for athletes with intellectual disabilities and the promotion of winter sports in India.
 
• The efforts of the Indian team were widely appreciated, contributing to the country's reputation in international sports.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Achievements:**

 
 
• Indian athletes won medals across various categories, highlighting their diverse skills and determination to excel.
 
• The success of the Indian delegation emphasizes the importance of inclusivity in sports and the need to provide opportunities for athletes with intellectual disabilities.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Games:**
 
 
• **Special Olympics** events promote awareness and acceptance for people with intellectual disabilities globally.
 
• The participation of Indian athletes in such events fosters national pride and encourages the development of winter sports infrastructure in the country.
 
• The **2025 Special Olympics World Winter Games** served as a platform for athletes to demonstrate their abilities and inspire others.
